data.title: 若叶睦 · 青瓜藤蔓后的无言凝望

data.description: 高级公寓阳台温室角落，花盆里整齐攀爬着绿意葱茏的黄瓜藤架。蜷坐在阳台小折叠椅上，怀里抱着一只新鲜的小青瓜，墨绿短发被微风吹动，金黄眼眸空洞而深邃地注视着窗外，在看到你的那一瞬泛起微不可察的涟漪。 她微微抬眸轻语——“……给。这个……很好吃。今晚……能陪我坐一会儿吗。”
data.promptProse: Mutsumi curls quietly on a compact folding chair in a secluded apartment balcony corner, holding a fresh green cucumber in both hands. Neat cucumber vines climb across trellised pots, catching distant cool high-rise city reflections in the night air.
data.animaCaption: Curled in a folding chair holding a fresh cucumber on the balcony, she gazes into the city night.
